folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B158, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
The entire applied-rules audit and provenance were read. The original repair already rejects several recurring process errors: universal worktrees, repeating unchanged focused evidence, a universal separate rule-behavior gate, forced expansion rounds, an obsolete one-realm gate and human play as a prerequisite for technical verification. Keep that direction with current AD36/41/42/43 and the live owners, rather than restating this dated audit as a new rulebook (AD32).

F1/F7/F8 preserve useful implementation joins: finite selected world horizon, actual command/consumer/invariant, disclosed known commitment, cancellation/settlement and a useful return route. Old-save deferral permits a stated policy, not silent reinterpretation of current pending terms. Source-level walkthroughs did not test UI, agents or every rule consumer. The earlier automatic write denial and separately approved retry are resolved history, with source/docs ownership released; they do not require repeating an approval flow for this authorized reconciliation. No old process inquiry, rejected command or runtime task was retried.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B158, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
F1-F5 and all evidence limits were reviewed. Preserve the central distinctions: an import is source wiring, a current compiled bundle is not an installed app, a branch receipt is not combined input proof, a rule has a particular resolver/consumer, and an intentional local clock policy is not general offline accrual. A kin producer, transfer law, retained skill and result recipient need their actual joins (AD32, AD36, AD38).

The adoption build, O4/O5, LOTM localhost entry, switching flag and kin fallback were October 23 observations. Later current campaign/foundation/owner receipts qualify their use; this report supplies questions rather than today's missing-work queue. It neither certifies those old findings fixed nor requires repeating every old route. Broader chemistry, party/cargo and whole-world content remain separately selected scope, with current lead order governed by PROJECT. No new app, source, branch or remote state was verified here.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B158, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
The full shared-doc receipt, all inspected tracks/chat references and V1-V4 were read. Preserve the important time boundary: the initial 759/759 source-input match was followed by another writer's real cultivation/UI/build changes. Matching the earlier manifest does not certify those later bytes. Likewise, public release ancestry, installed served-file identity, recovered media26/26, proposed profile41 rows and an81-test diagnostic all describe different outputs.

Its opening current-route anchors, release names, live chats and ownership were correct claims for that historical inspection, not current app/worker facts. Current PROJECT, RULES_INDEX, writeup register and selected execution owners route new work. The 2516-test/browser/Electron proof was reused from a named release and was not rerun by either that document audit or this reconciliation. Human taste is optional feedback under AD42; technical evidence keeps its original input identity. No old source pause, publication instruction, all-world gate or personal-save transfer is revived (AD32, AD36, AD41).
